title: Zesty Slovakian Basil Bowl
description: A light, aerated bowl of quinoa, sweet basil, and a tangy horapa yogurt sauce that feels like a solo dinner dish from Slovakia.

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.notes: rinsed and cooked in boiling water until fluffy

instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in a pot of boiling water for 10 minutes until fluffy and tender.
While the quinoa cooks, whisk the low‑fat Greek yogurt with lemon juice and horapa paste in a bowl until smooth.
Heat the yogurt mixture gently in a bain‑marie until it reaches 40°C, then remove from heat and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, and chopped basil.
Pour the warmed horapa yogurt sauce over the quinoa mixture and toss gently to coat evenly.
Season the bowl with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Top the dish with sliced scallions for a fresh crunch.
Serve immediately as a solo, aerated dinner bowl.
Optional: garnish with a few extra basil leaves before serving.
